newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on blue-chip buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on blue-chip buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Sunday on blue-chip buying despite an opposition-called general strike in Karachi and are likely to open mixed on Monday's clearing day, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 9.34 points, or 0.69 percent, up at 1,363.01 amid 109 losers and 78 gainers.

One dealer attributed the rise to a meeting of the presidents of the country's three bourses with Investment Minister Asif Ali Zardari on Sunday to find ways to improve depressed stock markets. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
